verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the OpenAI app listing, which counts "4 triggers" alongside actions in Pipedream's catalog. That suggests event triggers exist, but nothing shows a user defining rules that link those events to automatic actions. The rest of the pack describes on-demand tool calls made by an agent. Missing for 10: documentation of user-defined event-to-action rules, details of how triggers fire and invoke actions, coverage of conditions/filtering, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
